Let's propose.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_MaNcihYmu0QF2UhTdR6Z2843","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { fetch } from \"zttp:fetch\";\nimport { schemaCompile, validateObject } from \"zttp:validate\";\n\nschemaCompile(\"cityQuery\", '{\"type\":\"object\",\"required\":[\"city\"],\"properties\":{\"city\":{\"type\":\"string\",\"minLength\":1,\"maxLength\":64}}}');\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): Proof<Response,\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"fault_covered\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n> {\n  const checked = validateObject(\"cityQuery\", { city: req.query.city });\n  if (!checked.ok) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing or invalid city query parameter\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  const upstream = fetch(\"https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast\", {\n    query: { city: checked.value.city },\n    maxResponseBytes: 65536\n  });\n  if (!upstream.ok) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"weather service unavailable\" }, { status: 502 });\n  }\n  return Response.json(upstream.json());\n}\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":20605,"completion_tokens":825,"total_tokens":21430,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":4224},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":425},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":4224,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":16381},"system_fingerprint":"bc19ba97cbe016479903222bb1578db6"}
